item.title: Webinar: How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market
item.description: Date: Wednesday, November 4, 2026 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM - Generative AI tools have made it easy for job seekers to produce nearly identical resumes and application materials. As a result, recruiters are now receiving hundreds of generic resumes that look and sound the same. With so many identical resumes, recruiters are increasingly ignoring AI-written submissions, and the odds of your resume being selected are slim. So, how do you stand out in an AI-driven job market? By taking a different…

item.title: Graduate Student Lunch and Learn- Personal financial management - Registration Required
item.description: Date: Wednesday, November 4, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM - Associate Dean Dr. Brian Clark presents insight into personal financial management. The core areas of managing personal finance consist of income, spending, investments, and protection. Learn how to develop strategies for managing budgeting, emergency funds, debt, and more. Registration is required. Email sanchn2@rpi.edu.

item.description: Date: Wednesday, November 4, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:45 PM - One of the most common struggles PhDs face in their job search is identifying nonacademic career options that feel like a genuine fit. With a specialized background, it can be difficult to know where to begin or how to evaluate whether a career path aligns with your skills, values, and goals. item.title: RPI Faculty and Staff Quick Learn Webinar: Tips for Improving Online Breakout Room Sessions
item.description: Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 11:30 AM - 12:00 PM - In this webinar we will review tips and tricks to creating more productive breakout sessions. In this session, we will not be learning “how to” use the breakout room feature in Webex but we will be strategizing on how to improve the engagement in the sessions by offering roles, mixing things up, and creating connections. To register for this workshop and see a list of other upcoming workshops, please use the website listed in the See section.

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Workshop- Book Discussion- Atomic Habits
item.description: Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026 1:00 PM - 3:00 PM - This session is designed to facilitate an open discussion of Atomic Habits by James Clear. Participants will reflect on the book’s key concepts, share perspectives, and discuss practical ways to apply its principles to personal and professional growth.

item.title: Handshake Training for Faculty & Staff
item.description: Are you hiring students for the spring semester? The Center for Career & Professional Development (CCPD) will host a virtual training for faculty and staff interested in posting their on-campus job or research opportunities in Handshake. The training will take place on Wednesday, November 4th from 11-11:45am. Learn about the job board system, writing strong postings, and see a demo of the platform. If you are interested in attending or have questions, please email Nicole Doran at stongn@rpi.edu.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Certifications & Skill Development in Percipio
item.description: This course introduces the tools available in Percipio to support growth through certifications and skill benchmarks. You’ll learn how to identify relevant certifications and use benchmark assessments to measure current knowledge. Perfect for employees and supervisors alike, this session will help you navigate the platform’s upskilling features and align learning with career development objectives.
